name: pro-pdd
description: Default Define + Plan skills: interview-me and idea-refine (Define-phase intent extraction and idea refinement, forked from addyosmani/agent-skills), brainstorming, written implementation plans, and lavish — a bridge plus /lavish command for the kunchenguid/lavish-axi CLI that renders agent output (plans, tables, diagrams, diffs, reports) as reviewable HTML artifacts the user annotates in the browser (installed on demand via /lavish-engine). Depends on pro-execution for worktree and subagent execution handoff.
